From: Liam O'Connor <liam@seabound.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Hart <emma@seabound.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor intake — PO anchoring and spend cap question

Hi Jordan,

We're finishing the vendor intake paperwork and hit two blockers before we can move to payment terms:

1) PO number request: our procurement team requires a provisional/anchoring PO number to map invoices while your onboarding forms are processing. Can you confirm whether Redwood can issue a provisional PO or reference number today?

2) Spend-cap smoothing: our finance group needs a short note confirming the monthly spend cap and whether Redwood can smooth invoice spikes across the quarter for our initial ramp. We currently expect a $120K monthly run rate the first quarter.

Also, one of the line items in the onboarding form ("Extra support hours") doesn't have an SKU/line code. Attaching our intake checklist separately.

Can someone from ops help? We'd like to close these before our first integration run next week.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement — Seabound.ai
liam@seabound.ai
Attachment: seabound-intake-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@seabound.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake — PO anchoring and spend cap question

Hi Liam — thanks for flagging this. Short answers up front:

- We can provide a provisional PO reference today (internal-stub) while the formal PO is issued by our procurement team.
- We can also add a short smoothing note that allows invoice variance within a defined band for the first 90 days; I'll need procurement ops to confirm the exact wording and limits.

Ben / Monica — can one of you generate the provisional PO reference and verify the line item mapping for "Extra support hours"? If possible, attach the provisional PDF and a DocuSign link for Seabound to sign. Liam, if you can provide the intended spend profile (month-by-month) I'll include that in the smoothing note.

Jordan Blake
Sales — Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Vendor intake — provisional PO & line code clarification

Thanks Jordan. Liam — looping in procurement ops. Two quick items:

1) Provisional PO reference: we can issue a provisional PO in our system called an "activation stub". That reference will let your AP map invoices immediately. I have prepared a template (attached).

2) Line code: on the onboarding form "Extra support hours" should map to SKU RW-SVC-HOURS and default to line code 3100. The lack of SKU was likely a missed dropdown in your intake.

I've attached the PO_ISSUANCE_TEMPLATE.pdf for internal use. If you confirm the month-by-month numbers, Monica will finalize the DocuSign envelope and generate PO-RW-2025-1552 as the provisional/anchoring PO.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachment: PO_ISSUANCE_TEMPLATE.pdf (application/pdf)

Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Seabound provisional PO and spend-smoothing note (PO-RW-2025-1552)

Hi Liam / Jordan,

I've created the provisional PO and the DocuSign envelope. Details below:

- Provisional PO: PO-RW-2025-1552 (attachment: Seabound_PO-PO-RW-2025-1552.pdf) — this is the anchoring reference you can use for invoice routing.
- Line mapping: "Extra support hours" mapped to SKU RW-SVC-HOURS, line code 3100 (confirmed).
- Spend smoothing: Redwood will allow invoice variance up to +/- 30% month-over-month for the first 90 days to accommodate ramp. For clarity, the smoothing note will be included as an addendum to the provisional PO; final committed monthly caps remain subject to the signed SOW and PO.

Action items for Seabound:
- Please sign the DocuSign envelope (link below) to accept the provisional PO.
- Share the expected month-by-month spend profile; you mentioned a $120K monthly run rate initially — if you can break that into the first three months we'll record it in the addendum.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Seabound/EnvelopeID-9a7b2
Attachment: Seabound_PO-PO-RW-2025-1552.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: onboarding-form-seabound.csv (text/csv)

If you need the PO pushed to a different code or a temporary credit hold applied, let me know and we can route to finance.

Cheers,
Monica Patel

Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Liam
